entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: This is delicious... I think it's been years[n]since the last time I got to actually enjoy[n]cake.
But now you've got me.
You're no longer alone.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...Pretty smooth.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Those lines don't work the best when[n]you've got cream on your nose.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It reminds me you're still the younger[n]one here, and how I should be looking[n]out for you as the adult...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But somehow, I always end up running[n]to you for help.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Honestly, I really don't like that you[n]keep putting yourself in danger.[n]Why does it have to be you?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Still, I can't get mad at you for following[n]your heart. It's the only reason I got[n]my life back.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: So... thank you. Really.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: And congratulations on everything[n]you've accomplished, too.
Why thank me?
I didn't do anything.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I owe you a lot. Not just because of[n]the Phantom Thieves work, but[n]what you've done for me...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You helped me remember what[n]I really wanted to do with my life.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, shut up and let me thank you.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You helped me remember why[n]I got into teaching at all.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's why I got you a little[n]something. Here.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: It's a pretty good pen case, so it'll be[n]good for school, right?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: You can carry it with you, and...[n]I thought maybe you could look[n]at it and think of me.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey, um... thank you. For loving me,[n]I mean.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I know it doesn't exactly look good.[n]A teacher and a student shouldn't[n]have a relationship like ours.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But, this... this is the happiest I've ever[n]been.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: That's enough serious stuff for one[n]night. Let's get to the fun part!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Oh, yikes.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I was wondering what that was...[n]It's really snowing a lot harder[n]out there.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I don't know if the trains can still run[n]in this weather...
You could spend the night.
Well, that works out nicely.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Whoa whoa whoa, down boy![n]That's not happening!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: ...But I will hang around a little[n]longer, at least.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: How's that? Oh, never mind.[n]I see where you're going with this.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: But no! We're not doing any of that stuff[n]until it won't ruin our lives!

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: I'll stick around a little longer for you,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Just bear with me for now, okay?

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Heh... I never thought I'd spend[n]a quiet Christmas Eve with you.[n]It feels like a dream...

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Well, we're both here, and we're both[n]happy, so... for now, life's pretty good.

entries.speaker: Kawakami
entries.en: Hey. I want to stay close for a little[n]longer—do you mind?
Kawakami and I spent some[n]time alone together...
